[Problem]{.card-kicker} **subtree sizes after reparenting** [LC 3331 · Find Subtree Sizes After Changes](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-subtree-sizes-after-changes/){difficulty="Medium"}

The new parent of $x$ is an original ancestor, so a DFS of the original tree sees that ancestor before $x$. While the DFS is inside $x$, the vertices entered and not yet left are exactly the ancestors. `last[c]` remembers the deepest of them with letter $c$. Restore it when the DFS leaves $x$, and the sibling sees the path without $x$.

[Solved in full in @sec-tr-p4-sizes.]{.card-link}
